evidence: Heavily alters wallet transaction construction, coin selection, fee bumping, wallet database storage, and wallet RPCs across src/wallet/.
rationale: This PR adds sending support for BIP 352 silent payment addresses across wallet transaction creation and fee bumping RPCs. Users currently 'cannot pay silent payment recipients using Bitcoin Core wallet RPCs or the GUI' (PR description), making this a major privacy feature that also unblocks subsequent silent payments work.
